review: Product and quality, separate from correctness review
acceptedLayout: User-reviewed fourth HTML preview plus final request to put HTTPS controls above target entries in both states
implemented: Tokyo Night styling and consistent tilted logo; no preview scenario controls or demonstration traffic in the product.
Creation and pairing on the left, network identity on the right, collapsible help, own-device row and peer-only direct counts.
Dedicated settings pages with global save, restore and default drafts; live global pending indicators persist across page changes.
Single-line source rows, add/remove/test actions and a unified HTTPS switch above target entries; server address configured separately.
Pairing code and direct invitation are separate, mode-gated inputs. Guidance only describes the active method; both applications require approval.
Explicit exit confirmation below Join Network; owner deletion remains on the creation page. Ordinary service registration is an explicit UAC action, not an uninstall toggle.
compatibility: Existing networks and credentials are retained. New SL6 invitations require updated clients; legacy SL5 preauthorization codes must be regenerated for the new UI flow.
qualityScope: Actual local UI and isolated/native loopback regression; public-WAN Moonlight behavior, eight Windows stacks, extended stress and cross-account matrices are not claimed.
dailyInstallations: Not automatically replaced during build and publication
